note: Certification by the international firm TUV Rheinland, not shown to be a certifier accredited in Tunisia or the standards body; the document names no in-country certifier, so no certification fact (class other).

systems.system: DataXion datacenter certifications (ISO 27001:22, PCI DSS v4.0, Uptime Tier IV, APSAD R7 and R13)

note: Private operator's own claims; the document names no certifier for ISO 27001 (Uptime Institute, PCI and APSAD are not the standards body or an in-country certifier), so no certification fact (class other).

facts.fact: The Libyan national standards centre reports that Tunisia's delegation at the 20th Libya-Tunisia working group on mutual recognition of conformity certificates was headed by the Institut national de la normalisation et de la propriete industrielle (INNORPI), which it treats as Tunisia's national standards institute; the document does not mention the law that set it up or any IT standard.

systems.country_label: Institut National de la Normalisation et de la Propriete Industrielle

note: No certification fact: the mutual-recognition programme covers conformity certificates and marks in general, names no IT or data standard and no certifier.

The passages state general rules of the national standardization system (definition of a standard, public services built on national standards) but name no standards body and no IT or data standard, and no certification.

facts.fact: INNORPI, the Institut National de la Normalisation et de la Propriete Industrielle, issued standardization bulletin no. 441 on 25 May 2026 opening a two-month public enquiry on draft Tunisian standards under law 38-2009 and decree 2011-1083; the drafts (measurement, quality management, electrical and fibre-optic cable standards) include no information technology, information security, software or data standard.

note: Not recorded as published or none: one enquiry bulletin is not the catalogue, and its fibre-optic cable and measurement standards are not IT or data standards; no certification stated.

facts.fact: ISO's registry entry describes INNORPI as a public institution under the Ministry of Industry in charge of standardization and product and quality systems certification.
